audience.programmeDescription: Leiden French Language and Culture combines advanced French with French and Francophone literature, linguistics, cultural history and research. It examines French-speaking societies and cultural expression in France and across the world.

curriculum.limitation: Verified partial allocation: 165 of 180 EC. The remaining 15 EC concern the alternating Poetry and Theatre research/methodology course and Metamorphoses of the Novel. Their applicable entry and cycle conditions need confirmation. The displayed seminars require at least 45 EC of first-year French study. Thesis entry requires the French first-year examination, sufficient research preparation and the written-expression requirements; workshop participation is compulsory. The 30-EC open space remains subject to approval and overlap rules.
